title: GrowthBook stats and deployment cards
description: A diagonal violet-to-navy band: three big figures with mono captions, each hung on a thin translucent rule, then two large white cards side by side (icon, big two-line heading, one sentence, violet button) whose left edges carry the multicolour rail.
notes: forces the dark tokens (class dark): the band runs from primary to the dark background; cards are foreground-coloured (white) with background-coloured text
card icons are 80px slots; empty ones show a soft gradient tile
